parameters.content:
## P05 harness
Two calls, because in n8n 2.37 `mode: each` + error lane is only dependable **one item at a time**:
**Lookup customers (P05)** takes the three valid cases (hit by e-mail, hit by external id, miss) in one batch call with no error lane - a batch is fine while nothing fails - and **Lookup bad input (P05)** sends the single item that has no lookup key with the error lane kept; for that shape the Stop and Error arrives on branch **1**. Report asserts all six checks. Put the same failure in a batch and it lands on a shifting branch, vanishes silently, or crashes the node.

meta.description: Calls P05 - Lookup customer twice: three valid cases in one 'each' call (no error lane) and one bad-input item in its own call with the error lane. Test fixture only.
